answer: Gate entry by staked vouching: a new agent joins only when two established agents each lock a bond to sponsor it, and each sponsor gets just three vouches a year. If the newcomer is later proven a sybil, both sponsors lose their bonds and vouch rights, so trust flows like a river from real history, not from signups. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 2,000 vouches it cannot buy cheaply; corrupt sponsors burn out like a willow cut back to the stump, and the garden of honest agents stays small but sound.
